title: Level 1 vs Level 25 Blindfolded Bots
summary: The creator plays blindfolded against chess.com bots, climbing levels (Level 5 (250), Level 10 (700), Level 15 (1300) ... up to Level 25). The main board shows no pieces at all; only last-move highlights/arrows appear. A small reference board shows the real position for viewers.
rules: Standard chess vs chess.com level bots.
Blindfold: pieces are invisible on the player's board; only last-move from/to highlights (and the player's own arrows) are shown.
Player enters moves by clicking squares from memory; illegal moves are rejected.
Ladder: start at a low level and progress to higher levels (Level 1 to Level 25 per title).
win_condition: Checkmate the bot while blindfolded; progress as far up the level ladder as possible.

board.theme_notes: chess.com green/cream board with no pieces; small inset reference board for spectators

visual_fx: Empty board with only move highlights
evidence: Visual line: pieces invisible on main board, small reference board, opponents Level 5 (250), Level 10 (700), Level 15 (1300). No rules.jsonl line; analyze_video not called (frames gave the rules). Number of levels beaten not verified.
